task: show me how to change the cursor type

evidence.description: Brand Kit → Screen Clips shows Cursor Style = Pointer-first, with no unsaved-changes buttons and no trace of the old Arrow-first value

visualCheck.scope: Brand-wide default — "Default Brand" Brand Kit → Screen Clips → Screen Clip Settings → Cursor → Cursor Style.
visualCheck.why: The frame shows the brand-level Screen Clip Settings panel (Brand Kit highlighted in the sidebar, "Default Brand Brand Kit" header) with Cursor Style reading "Pointer-first" and no pending Save Changes/Cancel bar, supporting the claim that the brand-scope cursor type was changed and saved.

summary: Changed the cursor type in Yarn. Route: sidebar → Brand Kit → Screen Clips → Cursor Style combobox → selected "Pointer-first" (was "Arrow-first"), then clicked Save Changes; the Save Changes/Cancel buttons disappeared and the control still reads "Pointer-first".\n\nScope choice: I used the BRAND scope (Brand Kit → Screen Clips) rather than a single project's override, because the task was phrased generally ("change the cursor type") with no project named — that reads as changing the default for all screen clips. The equivalent per-project setting lives under Project actions ⋯ → Screen Clip Settings… and was intentionally left untouched. Value choice: "Pointer-first" was picked as a sensible alternative since the task didn't specify one (other option: "Original").
